# Security Policy

## Supported versions

Only the latest release of `ytcc-pipeline` receives security fixes. The project is pre-1.0; pinning to a specific version is your responsibility.

## Reporting a vulnerability

Do **not** open a public GitHub issue for security reports.

Use one of the following:

- GitHub's [private vulnerability reporting](https://github.com/ozefe/ytcc-pipeline/security/advisories/new) (preferred).
- Email <hi@efe.cv> with `[security]` in the subject.

Include a description of the issue, the affected version, and a minimal reproducer if you have one.

## What to expect

- Credit in the release notes, unless you'd rather stay anonymous.
